title: MS-DOS (MIT) — Microsoft Multitasking MS-DOS boot floppy
blocker: Multitasking-beta DOS core halts at 'Internal Error 4560 / HardErr: no handler' before COMMAND.COM's prompt on the emulated AT (reproduces with CONFIG.SYS/AUTOEXEC.BAT removed).
notes: Genuinely-libre MIT bytes: Microsoft's Multitasking MS-DOS boot disk (microsoft/MS-DOS v4.0-ozzie). Raw FAT12 360KB image with IBMBIO.COM/IBMDOS.COM/COMMAND.COM. Boots on the free-386 to the authentic 'MS-DOS version 4.00 Copyright ... Microsoft Corp.' banner, then the multitasking beta core faults at Internal Error 4560 before a prompt -- honestly pinned, not a claimed prompt. A clean A:\> prompt needs mainstream MS-DOS 4.00 built from v4.0/src (a DOS+MASM source build, not a fetch). Fetched, never re-hosted.
